entities.name: Pikepierce
entities.description: Renegade goblin of Ulgrotha, agile spear fighter whose arrogance led to his death at Jekelth's hands.

entities.name: Jekelth
entities.description: Minotaur warrior who feigned resignation and killed Pikepierce.

entities.name: Anaba
entities.description: Minotaurs among whom Pikepierce's death became legend.

events.summary: Pikepierce brings the minotaur Jekelth to his knees with quick movements and aggressive tactics.
events.quote: brought the mighty minotaur warrior to his knees

events.summary: Pikepierce taunts Jekelth, who feigns acceptance of death and then regains the upper hand and kills Pikepierce.

relations.quote: regain the upper hand and ultimately kill him
his encounter with the minotaur Jekelth
